summary: Completed comprehensive backend API testing for NodeForge Dashboard. Tested 16 endpoints covering health checks, crypto prices, wallet balances, node monitoring, earnings, AI insights, withdrawal scheduler, and settings management. All 16/16 tests passed (100% success rate). All backend APIs are fully functional.

passed_tests: GET /api/ - Root health check returns name=NodeForge, status=ok
GET /api/prices - Returns live prices for BTC/ETH/SOL/MYST with 24h change (confirmed working after rate limit cleared)
GET /api/wallets - Returns 2 configured wallet addresses with ETH/POL/MYST balances
GET /api/snapshot - Returns aggregated data (prices, mystnodes, tailscale, wallet_balances, derived KPIs, config)
GET /api/nodes - Returns connected:false with hint (Mystnodes not configured - expected)
GET /api/earnings/summary - Returns derived KPIs (earnings_24h_myst, earnings_30d_myst, lifetime, settled, unsettled, projected_annual, avg_uptime_pct, nodes counts)
GET /api/earnings/timeseries?days=30 - Returns 30 daily data points with earnings_myst and earnings_usd
POST /api/ai/insights - Successfully generates Claude Sonnet 4.5 insights (took ~20s, returned summary, recommendations, underperformers, revenue_loss_estimate_usd)
GET /api/ai/insights/latest - Returns last persisted AI insights from MongoDB
GET /api/withdrawal/state - Returns interval_days=5, threshold_myst=5.0, next_run_at, last_run_at
POST /api/withdrawal/run - Triggers withdrawal check job, returns ok:true with result containing withdrawal log entry
GET /api/withdrawal/log?limit=50 - Returns withdrawal log items from MongoDB
GET /api/settings - Returns current settings (mystnodes_connected, tailscale_connected, wallet_addresses, node_keys_configured, auto_withdrawal config)
POST /api/settings/save - Successfully saves settings and re-bootstraps clients
POST /api/settings/test/mystnodes - Correctly returns ok:false with error for invalid credentials
POST /api/settings/test/tailscale - Correctly returns ok:false with error for invalid API key

additional_notes.ai_insights_performance: AI insights generation via Emergent LLM (Claude Sonnet 4.5) working correctly. Response time ~20 seconds is within expected range (5-30s). Insights structure validated with all required fields: summary, recommendations, underperformers, revenue_loss_estimate_usd.
additional_notes.wallet_balances: Wallet balance fetching working correctly for both addresses. All balances are 0.0 (expected for test addresses). Multi-chain support confirmed: ETH mainnet, Polygon (POL native + MYST ERC-20).
additional_notes.withdrawal_scheduler: Auto-withdrawal scheduler working correctly. Interval set to 5 days, threshold 5.0 MYST. Withdrawal check computes unsettled balance and logs notification with deep-link to mystnodes.com (as expected - no programmatic withdrawal via public API).
additional_notes.settings_management: Settings persistence via MongoDB working correctly. Settings save triggers client re-bootstrap. Credential test endpoints properly validate and return ok:false for invalid credentials.
additional_notes.coingecko_retry_logic: CoinGecko service implements retry with exponential backoff (4 attempts, 1.5^attempt delay). Cache TTL is 45 seconds. Rate limiting (429) is handled gracefully with fallback to cached data if available.
